vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}

{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}

{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

	oPos.y = mac.y;
	/* 31 */
	A = r10.xyzw;
	B = c[2].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.z = mac.z;
	/* 32 */
	A = r10.xyzw;
	B = c[3].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.w = mac.w;
	/* 33 */
	A = r10.xyzw;
	B = c[8].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oFog.xw = mac.xw;
	/* 34 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[13].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r3.x = mac.x;
	/* 35 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[14].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r3.y = mac.y;
	/* 36 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = c[58].xyzw;
	C = oPos.wwww;
	mac = A * B;
	ilu = nv2a_rcc(C.x);
	clip_position = oPos;
	clip_captured = true;
	r1.x = ilu.x;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 37 */
	A = r2.xyzw;
	B = r2.xyzw;
	C = r3.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz));
	ilu = C;
	r2.w = mac.w;
	oT0.xy = ilu.xy;
	/* 38 */
	A = r3.xyzw;
	B = v0.xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A;
	oT2.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 39 */
	A = r3.xyzw;
	B = c[12].xyzw;
	C = r2.wwww;
	mac = A * B;
	ilu = vec4(inversesqrt(abs(C.x)));
	r1.w = ilu.w;
	oT1.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 40 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = r1.xxxx;
	C = c[59].xyzw;
	mac = A * B + C;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 41 */
	A = r2.xyzw;
	B = r1.wwww;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	r3.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 42 */
	A = r3.xyzw;
	B = r0.xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz));
	r4.xyzw = mac.xyzw;
	/* 43 */
	A = r4.xyzw;
	B = c[15].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	r5.xyzw = mac.xyzw;
	/* 44 */
	A = r5.xyzw;
	B = v0.xyzw;
	C = c[16].xyzw;
	mac = A + C;
	oD1.xyzw = mac.xyzw;
	/* undo the screen-space conversion done with c[-38] and c[-37] */
	vec3 scale = vec3(viewport_scale.x != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.x : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.y != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.y : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.z != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.z : 1.0);
	if (clip_captured)
		gl_Position = vec4((clip_position.xyz * c[58].xyz + (c[59].xyz + vec3(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5, 0.0)
			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else
		gl_Position = vec4((vec3(oPos.xy + vec2(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5), oPos.z) - viewport_offset.xyz) / scale * oPos.w, oPos.w);
	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;
	gl_Position.z = 2.0 * gl_Position.z - gl_Position.w;
	gl_PointSize = oPts.x;
	xD0 = clamp(oD0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xD1 = clamp(oD1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB0 = clamp(oB0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB1 = clamp(oB1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xT0 = oT0;
	xT1 = oT1;
	xT2 = oT2;
	xT3 = oT3;
	xFog = oFog.x;
}

	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(r0.a, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);

		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;

		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(r0.b, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(r1.b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(v1.a, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aAB;
		r1.a = aCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 3 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (0.5 - max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0));

		vec3 cB = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);

		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);

		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r1.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 6 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		t0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 7 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec3(r1.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec3(ps_final_c0.a), 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(v0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
	vec3 fB = clamp(ef_product.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(ps_final_c0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(t2.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

		viewport_scale.z != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.z : 1.0);
	if (clip_captured)
		gl_Position = vec4((clip_position.xyz * c[58].xyz + (c[59].xyz + vec3(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5, 0.0)
			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else
		gl_Position = vec4((vec3(oPos.xy + vec2(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5), oPos.z) - viewport_offset.xyz) / scale * oPos.w, oPos.w);
	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;
	gl_Position.z = 2.0 * gl_Position.z - gl_Position.w;
	gl_PointSize = oPts.x;
	xD0 = clamp(oD0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xD1 = clamp(oD1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB0 = clamp(oB0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB1 = clamp(oB1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xT0 = oT0;
	xT1 = oT1;
	xT2 = oT2;
	xT3 = oT3;
	xFog = oFog.x;

{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}

{

}

	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}

	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}

	t2 = texture(tex2, (vec4(dot1, dot2, dot3, 1.0)).xyz, texture_lod_bias[2]);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 12 */
	dot3 = dot(xT3.xyz, ((t0.rgb * 255.0 - 128.0) / 127.0));
	{
		vec3 n = vec3(dot1, dot2, dot3);
		vec3 e = vec3(xT1.w, xT2.w, xT3.w);
		vec3 r = 2.0 * n * dot(n, e) / max(dot(n, n), 1.0e-20) - e;
		t3 = texture(tex3, (vec4(r, 1.0)).xyz, texture_lod_bias[3]);
	}
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (2.0 * max(t2.rgb, 0.0) - 1.0);
		vec3 cB = (2.0 * max(ps_c0[0].rgb, 0.0) - 1.0);
		vec3 cC = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = vec3(dot(cA, cB));
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
		r1.rgb = cCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
		r1.rgb = cCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r1.rgb = cCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 3 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (1.0 - clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cB = max(ps_c1[3].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(ps_c0[3].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = (1.0 - clamp(r0.b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aB = max(ps_c1[3].a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(r0.b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(ps_c0[3].a, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 4 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (1.0 - clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cB = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec3(r0.a), 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0)), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(ef_product.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	t1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 2, mode 0 */
	t2 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 0 */
	t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(ps_c0[0].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(ps_c1[0].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(vec3(v0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cC = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(v0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	float dot0 = 0.0, dot1 = 0.0, dot2 = 0.0, dot3 = 0.0;
	/* texture stage 0, mode 3 */
	t0 = texture(tex0, (xT0).xyz, texture_lod_bias[0]);
	/* texture stage 1, mode 1 */
	t1 = texture(tex1, (vec4(xT1.xyz / (xT1.w != 0.0 ? xT1.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[1].xy, texture_lod_bias[1]);
	/* texture stage 2, mode 0 */
	t2 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 0 */
	t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(ps_c1[0].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec3(ps_c1[0].a), 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t0.b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(v1.a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(t0.b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(ps_c0[0].a, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
		r1.rgb = cCD;
		r0.a = aCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(r1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t1.a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(ps_c1[1].a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aAB;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(vec3(v0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(r0.a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(v0.a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)

	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}

	x = abs(x);

	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);

layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragment_color;

uniform vec4 ps_c1[8];
uniform vec4 ps_final_c0;
uniform vec4 ps_final_c1;
uniform vec4 fog_color;
uniform vec4 fog_parameters;
uniform float alpha_reference;
uniform vec4 bump_matrix[4];
uniform vec4 bump_luminance[4];
uniform vec4 texture_scale[4];
uniform vec4 texture_lod_bias;
uniform sampler2D tex0;
uniform sampler2D tex1;
uniform sampler2D tex2;
uniform sampler2D tex3;
float signed_byte(float x)
{
	float b = floor(x * 255.0 + 0.5);
	return (b >= 128.0 ? b - 256.0 : b) / 127.0;
}
vec3 signed_bytes(vec3 x)
{
	return vec3(signed_byte(x.r), signed_byte(x.g), signed_byte(x.b));
}
void main()
{
	vec4 v0 = xD0;
	vec4 v1 = xD1;
	vec4 t0 = vec4(0.0), t1 = vec4(0.0), t2 = vec4(0.0), t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float dot0 = 0.0, dot1 = 0.0, dot2 = 0.0, dot3 = 0.0;
	/* texture stage 0, mode 1 */
	t0 = texture(tex0, (vec4(xT0.xyz / (xT0.w != 0.0 ? xT0.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[0].xy, texture_lod_bias[0]);
	if (t0.a == 0.0) discard;
	/* texture stage 1, mode 0 */
	t1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 2, mode 0 */
	t2 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 0 */
	t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(vec3(ps_c0[0].a), 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = (-t0.rgb);
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(ps_c1[0].a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(t0.b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(ps_c1[0].a, 0.0);
		float aD = max(t0.b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(r0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cB = max(ps_c0[1].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(ps_c1[1].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = (1.0 - 2.0 * max(r0.b, 0.0));
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aAB;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(ps_c1[2].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t0.b, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = (0.5 - max(ps_c1[2].a, 0.0));
		float aD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 3 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(ps_c0[3].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = r0.a >= 0.5 ? cCD : cAB;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(ps_c1[3].a, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(ps_c0[3].a, 0.0);
		float aD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = r0.a >= 0.5 ? aCD : aAB;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec3(t0.a), 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);

	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);

	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT0.y = mac.y;
	/* 3 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[17].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT1.x = mac.x;
	/* 4 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[18].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT1.y = mac.y;
	/* 5 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[19].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT2.x = mac.x;
	/* 6 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[20].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT2.y = mac.y;
	/* 7 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[21].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT3.x = mac.x;
	/* 8 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[22].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT3.y = mac.y;
	/* 9 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = c[58].xyzw;
	C = oPos.wwww;
	mac = A * B;
	ilu = nv2a_rcc(C.x);
	clip_position = oPos;
	clip_captured = true;
	r1.x = ilu.x;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 10 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = r1.xxxx;
	C = c[59].xyzw;
	mac = A * B + C;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* undo the screen-space conversion done with c[-38] and c[-37] */
	vec3 scale = vec3(viewport_scale.x != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.x : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.y != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.y : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.z != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.z : 1.0);
	if (clip_captured)
		gl_Position = vec4((clip_position.xyz * c[58].xyz + (c[59].xyz + vec3(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5, 0.0)
			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else
		gl_Position = vec4((vec3(oPos.xy + vec2(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5), oPos.z) - viewport_offset.xyz) / scale * oPos.w, oPos.w);
	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;
	gl_Position.z = 2.0 * gl_Position.z - gl_Position.w;
	gl_PointSize = oPts.x;
	xD0 = clamp(oD0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xD1 = clamp(oD1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB0 = clamp(oB0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB1 = clamp(oB1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xT0 = oT0;
	xT1 = oT1;
	xT2 = oT2;
	xT3 = oT3;
	xFog = oFog.x;
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	vec4 v5 = v5_in;
	vec4 v6 = v6_in;
	vec4 v7 = v7_in;

	vec4 r4 = vec4(0.0), r5 = vec4(0.0), r6 = vec4(0.0), r7 = vec4(0.0);
	vec4 r8 = vec4(0.0), r9 = vec4(0.0), r10 = vec4(0.0), r11 = vec4(0.0);
	vec4 oPos = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 oD0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), oD1 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);

{

		vec3 cB = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);

vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
		r1.rgb = cCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (1.0 - clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(r1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 3 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (1.0 - clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cB = max(ps_c1[0].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = vec3(dot(cA, cB));
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r1.rgb = cAB;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = (1.0 - clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
	float fG = clamp(r1.b, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	if (!(floor(clamp(result.a, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) > alpha_reference)) discard;
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r8.z = mac.z;
	/* 10 */
	A = v4.wwww;
	B = v4.xyzw;
	C = -r8.xyzw;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 11 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = c[58].xyzw;
	C = oPos.wwww;
	mac = A * B;
	ilu = nv2a_rcc(C.x);
	clip_position = oPos;
	clip_captured = true;
	r1.x = ilu.x;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 12 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = v4.zzzz;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = max(A, B);
	r8.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 13 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = r8.xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	r8.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 14 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = v4.wwww;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = min(A, B);
	r8.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 15 */
	A = r8.xxxx;
	B = v0.xyzw;
	C = r8.yyyy;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.x = mac.x;
	/* 16 */
	A = r8.zzzz;
	B = c[11].xxxx;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	r8.z = mac.z;
	/* 17 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = v4.wwww;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = min(A, B);
	r8.x = mac.x;
	/* 18 */
	A = v4.wwww;
	B = v4.xyzw;
	C = -r8.xyzw;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 19 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = r1.xxxx;
	C = c[59].xyzw;
	mac = A * B + C;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 20 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = r8.xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	r8.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 21 */
	A = r8.yyyy;
	B = v0.xyzw;
	C = -r8.xxxx;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.y = mac.y;
	/* 22 */
	A = c[11].yyyy;
	B = r8.yyyy;
	C = r8.xxxx;
	mac = A * B + C;
	r8.w = mac.w;
	/* 23 */
	A = r8.wwww;
	B = c[11].zzzz;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	r8.w = mac.w;
	/* 24 */
	A = -r8.xyzw;
	B = v4.xyzw;
	C = v4.wwww;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.zw = mac.zw;
	/* 25 */
	A = r8.zzzz;
	B = r8.wwww;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	oD0.w = mac.w;
	/* undo the screen-space conversion done with c[-38] and c[-37] */
	vec3 scale = vec3(viewport_scale.x != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.x : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.y != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.y : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.z != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.z : 1.0);
	if (clip_captured)
		gl_Position = vec4((clip_position.xyz * c[58].xyz + (c[59].xyz + vec3(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5, 0.0)
			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else
		gl_Position = vec4((vec3(oPos.xy + vec2(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5), oPos.z) - viewport_offset.xyz) / scale * oPos.w, oPos.w);
	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;
	gl_Position.z = 2.0 * gl_Position.z - gl_Position.w;
	gl_PointSize = oPts.x;
	xD0 = clamp(oD0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xD1 = clamp(oD1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB0 = clamp(oB0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB1 = clamp(oB1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xT0 = oT0;
	xT1 = oT1;
	xT2 = oT2;
	xT3 = oT3;
	xFog = oFog.x;
}

uniform vec4 bump_luminance[4];

uniform vec4 texture_lod_bias;

float signed_byte(float x)
{
	float b = floor(x * 255.0 + 0.5);
	return (b >= 128.0 ? b - 256.0 : b) / 127.0;
}
vec3 signed_bytes(vec3 x)
{
	return vec3(signed_byte(x.r), signed_byte(x.g), signed_byte(x.b));
}
void main()
{
	vec4 v0 = xD0;
	vec4 v1 = xD1;
	vec4 t0 = vec4(0.0), t1 = vec4(0.0), t2 = vec4(0.0), t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float dot0 = 0.0, dot1 = 0.0, dot2 = 0.0, dot3 = 0.0;
	/* texture stage 0, mode 1 */
	t0 = texture(tex0, (vec4(xT0.xyz / (xT0.w != 0.0 ? xT0.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[0].xy, texture_lod_bias[0]);
	/* texture stage 1, mode 0 */
	t1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 2, mode 0 */
	t2 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 0 */
	t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t0.a, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(v0.a, 0.0);
		float aD = max(v1.a, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;

		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
		r0.a = aAB;
		v0.a = aCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(vec3(v0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);

		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;

		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.z = mac.z;
	/* 17 */
	A = r2.xyzw;
	B = c[3].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.w = mac.w;
	/* 18 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[13].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r10.x = mac.x;
	/* 19 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[14].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r10.y = mac.y;
	/* 20 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = c[58].xyzw;
	C = oPos.wwww;
	mac = A * B;
	ilu = nv2a_rcc(C.x);
	clip_position = oPos;
	clip_captured = true;
	r1.x = ilu.x;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 21 */
	A = r10.xyzw;
	B = v0.xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A;
	oT0.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 22 */
	A = r10.xyzw;
	B = c[12].xyyy;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
	oT1.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 23 */
	A = oPos.xyzw;
	B = r1.xxxx;
	C = c[59].xyzw;
	mac = A * B + C;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* undo the screen-space conversion done with c[-38] and c[-37] */
	vec3 scale = vec3(viewport_scale.x != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.x : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.y != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.y : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.z != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.z : 1.0);
	if (clip_captured)
		gl_Position = vec4((clip_position.xyz * c[58].xyz + (c[59].xyz + vec3(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5, 0.0)
			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else
		gl_Position = vec4((vec3(oPos.xy + vec2(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5), oPos.z) - viewport_offset.xyz) / scale * oPos.w, oPos.w);
	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;
	gl_Position.z = 2.0 * gl_Position.z - gl_Position.w;
	gl_PointSize = oPts.x;
	xD0 = clamp(oD0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xD1 = clamp(oD1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB0 = clamp(oB0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB1 = clamp(oB1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xT0 = oT0;
	xT1 = oT1;
	xT2 = oT2;
	xT3 = oT3;
	xFog = oFog.x;

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	B = r1.xxxx;

	mac = A * B + C;
	oPos.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* undo the screen-space conversion done with c[-38] and c[-37] */
	vec3 scale = vec3(viewport_scale.x != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.x : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.y != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.y : 1.0,
		viewport_scale.z != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.z : 1.0);
	if (clip_captured)
		gl_Position = vec4((clip_position.xyz * c[58].xyz + (c[59].xyz + vec3(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5, 0.0)
			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else
		gl_Position = vec4((vec3(oPos.xy + vec2(0.5 + screen_offset, 0.5), oPos.z) - viewport_offset.xyz) / scale * oPos.w, oPos.w);
	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;
	gl_Position.z = 2.0 * gl_Position.z - gl_Position.w;
	gl_PointSize = oPts.x;
	xD0 = clamp(oD0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xD1 = clamp(oD1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB0 = clamp(oB0, 0.0, 1.0);
	xB1 = clamp(oB1, 0.0, 1.0);
	xT0 = oT0;
	xT1 = oT1;
	xT2 = oT2;
	xT3 = oT3;
	xFog = oFog.x;
}

		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);

		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = r0.a >= 0.5 ? aCD : aAB;
		aAB = clamp((aAB * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM * 4.0), -1.0, 1.0);

		vec3 cB = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);

		float aCD = aC * aD;

		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);

	}
	/* combiner stage 6 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(ps_c0[6].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 7 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(r0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cB = max(ps_c0[1].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(ps_c1[1].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = (1.0 - 2.0 * max(r0.b, 0.0));
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aAB;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(ps_c1[2].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t0.b, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = (0.5 - max(ps_c0[2].a, 0.0));
		float aD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 3 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(ps_c0[3].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = r0.a >= 0.5 ? cCD : cAB;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(ps_c1[3].a, 0.0);
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(ps_c0[3].a, 0.0);
		float aD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = r0.a >= 0.5 ? aCD : aAB;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec3(t0.a), 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

	int z = int(p) >> 22;

{

	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);

float signed_byte(float x)
{
	float b = floor(x * 255.0 + 0.5);
	return (b >= 128.0 ? b - 256.0 : b) / 127.0;
}

void main()
{
	vec4 v0 = xD0;
	vec4 v1 = xD1;

	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);

	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(ps_c0[0].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;

	vec3 fB = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);

	vec3 fD = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);

}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

S 35632 bf10006fb0e8a9da 4348
#version 300 es
precision highp float;
precision highp int;
precision highp sampler2D;
precision highp sampler3D;
precision highp samplerCube;
in vec4 xD0;
in vec4 xD1;
in vec4 xB0;
in vec4 xB1;
in vec4 xT0;
in vec4 xT1;
in vec4 xT2;
in vec4 xT3;
in float xFog;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragment_color;
uniform vec4 ps_c0[8];
uniform vec4 ps_c1[8];
uniform vec4 ps_final_c0;
uniform vec4 ps_final_c1;
uniform vec4 fog_color;
uniform vec4 fog_parameters;
uniform float alpha_reference;
uniform vec4 bump_matrix[4];
uniform vec4 bump_luminance[4];
uniform vec4 texture_scale[4];
uniform vec4 texture_lod_bias;
uniform sampler2D tex0;
uniform sampler2D tex1;
uniform sampler2D tex2;
uniform sampler2D tex3;
float signed_byte(float x)
{
	float b = floor(x * 255.0 + 0.5);
	return (b >= 128.0 ? b - 256.0 : b) / 127.0;
}
vec3 signed_bytes(vec3 x)
{
	return vec3(signed_byte(x.r), signed_byte(x.g), signed_byte(x.b));
}
void main()
{
	vec4 v0 = xD0;
	vec4 v1 = xD1;
	vec4 t0 = vec4(0.0), t1 = vec4(0.0), t2 = vec4(0.0), t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float dot0 = 0.0, dot1 = 0.0, dot2 = 0.0, dot3 = 0.0;
	/* texture stage 0, mode 1 */
	t0 = texture(tex0, (vec4(xT0.xyz / (xT0.w != 0.0 ? xT0.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[0].xy, texture_lod_bias[0]);
	/* texture stage 1, mode 1 */
	t1 = texture(tex1, (vec4(xT1.xyz / (xT1.w != 0.0 ? xT1.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[1].xy, texture_lod_bias[1]);
	/* texture stage 2, mode 1 */
	t2 = texture(tex2, (vec4(xT2.xyz / (xT2.w != 0.0 ? xT2.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[2].xy, texture_lod_bias[2]);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 0 */
	t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB * 2.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD * 2.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM * 2.0), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t0.a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(t1.a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
		r0.a = aAB;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t2.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(v0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(r0.a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(v0.a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r1.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aAB;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	if (!(floor(clamp(result.a, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) > alpha_reference)) discard;
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

	vec3 fD = clamp(r1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);

		t1.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 4 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(v0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		t3.rgb = cAB;
		v0.rgb = cCD;
	}
	/* combiner stage 5 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(ps_c1[5].rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(vec3(v0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cD = (-ps_c0[5].rgb);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r1.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 6 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		t0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 7 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec3(r1.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec3(ps_final_c0.a), 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(v0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
	vec3 fB = clamp(ef_product.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(ps_final_c0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(t0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	if (!(floor(clamp(result.a, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) > alpha_reference)) discard;
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	B = c[58].xyzw;

		viewport_scale.y != 0.0 ? viewport_scale.y : 1.0,

			- viewport_offset.xyz) * clip_position.w) / scale, clip_position.w);
	else

	gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;

precision highp float;
precision highp int;
precision highp sampler2D;
precision highp sampler3D;
precision highp samplerCube;
in vec4 xD0;
in vec4 xD1;
in vec4 xB0;
in vec4 xB1;
in vec4 xT0;
in vec4 xT1;
in vec4 xT2;
in vec4 xT3;
in float xFog;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragment_color;
uniform vec4 ps_c0[8];
uniform vec4 ps_c1[8];
uniform vec4 ps_final_c0;
uniform vec4 ps_final_c1;
uniform vec4 fog_color;
uniform vec4 fog_parameters;
uniform float alpha_reference;
uniform vec4 bump_matrix[4];
uniform vec4 bump_luminance[4];
uniform vec4 texture_scale[4];
uniform vec4 texture_lod_bias;
uniform sampler2D tex0;
uniform sampler2D tex1;
uniform sampler2D tex2;
uniform sampler2D tex3;
float signed_byte(float x)
{
	float b = floor(x * 255.0 + 0.5);
	return (b >= 128.0 ? b - 256.0 : b) / 127.0;
}
vec3 signed_bytes(vec3 x)
{
	return vec3(signed_byte(x.r), signed_byte(x.g), signed_byte(x.b));
}
void main()
{
	vec4 v0 = xD0;
	vec4 v1 = xD1;
	vec4 t0 = vec4(0.0), t1 = vec4(0.0), t2 = vec4(0.0), t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float dot0 = 0.0, dot1 = 0.0, dot2 = 0.0, dot3 = 0.0;
	/* texture stage 0, mode 1 */
	t0 = texture(tex0, (vec4(xT0.xyz / (xT0.w != 0.0 ? xT0.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[0].xy, texture_lod_bias[0]);
	/* texture stage 1, mode 1 */
	t1 = texture(tex1, (vec4(xT1.xyz / (xT1.w != 0.0 ? xT1.w : 1.0), 1.0)).xy * texture_scale[1].xy, texture_lod_bias[1]);
	/* texture stage 2, mode 0 */
	t2 = vec4(0.0);
	/* texture stage 3, mode 0 */
	t3 = vec4(0.0);
	float fog_factor = xFog;
	vec4 fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, clamp(fog_factor, 0.0, 1.0));
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, t0.a);
	vec4 r1 = vec4(0.0);
	/* combiner stage 0 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(t0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
		vec3 cC = max(t0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec3(t0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = (1.0 - clamp(t1.b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aAB;
	}

	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cAB;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(r0.a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(v0.a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

	t2 = vec4(0.0);

		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec3(ps_final_c0.a), 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = (1.0 - clamp(vec3(v0.a), 0.0, 1.0));
	vec3 fB = clamp(ef_product.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(ps_final_c0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(t0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	if (!(floor(clamp(result.a, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) > alpha_reference)) discard;
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 1 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(t1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(t1.a, 0.0);
		float aB = max(r0.a, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
		r0.a = aSUM;
	}
	/* combiner stage 2 */
	{
		vec3 cA = max(r0.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		float aA = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aD = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aAB = aA * aB;
		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);
		r0.rgb = cSUM;
	}
	vec4 ef_product = vec4(clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec4 v1r0_sum = vec4(clamp(v1.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) + clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0);
	vec3 fA = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fB = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fC = clamp(vec4(0.0).rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	float fG = clamp(r0.a, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);

		float aB = (1.0 - clamp(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0, 1.0));

		float aCD = aC * aD;
		float aSUM = aAB + aCD;
		aAB = clamp((aAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		aCD = clamp((aCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		aSUM = clamp((aSUM), -1.0, 1.0);

		r0.a = aSUM;
	}

	{
		vec3 cA = max(vec3(r0.a), 0.0);
		vec3 cB = max(t3.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cC = max(v1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cD = max(r1.rgb, 0.0);
		vec3 cAB = cA * cB;
		vec3 cCD = cC * cD;
		vec3 cSUM = cAB + cCD;
		cAB = clamp((cAB), -1.0, 1.0);
		cCD = clamp((cCD), -1.0, 1.0);
		cSUM = clamp((cSUM), -1.0, 1.0);

		float aB = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);
		float aC = max(vec4(0.0).b, 0.0);

		float aCD = aC * aD;

	vec3 fD = clamp(r0.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);

	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);

{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);

{
	float r = 1.0 / x;

	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);

	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);

vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

	vec4 result = vec4(fA * fB + (1.0 - fA) * fC + fD, fG);
	if (!(floor(clamp(result.a, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) > alpha_reference)) discard;
	fragment_color = clamp(result, 0.0, 1.0);
}

	int z = int(p) >> 22;

vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);

	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);

vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)

}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)

	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}

	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);

	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

#version 300 es

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

invariant gl_Position;
vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}

vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);

layout(std140) uniform halo_vertex_constants { vec4 c[192]; };
uniform vec4 viewport_scale;
uniform vec4 viewport_offset;
uniform float point_size;
uniform float screen_offset;
out vec4 xD0;
out vec4 xD1;
out vec4 xB0;
out vec4 xB1;
out vec4 xT0;
out vec4 xT1;
out vec4 xT2;
out vec4 xT3;
out float xFog;
invariant gl_Position;
vec4 unpack_normpacked3(uint p)
{
	int x = int(p << 21) >> 21;
	int y = int(p << 10) >> 21;
	int z = int(p) >> 22;
	return vec4(float(x) / 1023.0, float(y) / 1023.0, float(z) / 511.0, 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_rcc(float x)
{
	float r = 1.0 / x;
	if (r > 0.0) r = clamp(r, 5.42101e-20, 1.884467e+19);
	else r = clamp(r, -1.884467e+19, -5.42101e-20);
	return vec4(r);
}
vec4 nv2a_exp(float x)
{
	return vec4(exp2(floor(x)), fract(x), exp2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_log(float x)
{
	x = abs(x);
	if (x == 0.0) return vec4(-1.0e30, 1.0, -1.0e30, 1.0);
	float e = floor(log2(x));
	return vec4(e, x / exp2(e), log2(x), 1.0);
}
vec4 nv2a_lit(vec4 s)
{
	float specular = s.x > 0.0 ? pow(max(s.y, 0.0), clamp(s.w, -127.9961, 127.9961)) : 0.0;
	return vec4(1.0, max(s.x, 0.0), specular, 1.0);
}
layout(location = 0) in vec4 v0_in;
layout(location = 1) in uint v1_packed;
layout(location = 2) in uint v2_packed;
layout(location = 3) in uint v3_packed;
layout(location = 4) in vec4 v4_in;
layout(location = 5) in vec4 v5_in;
layout(location = 6) in vec4 v6_in;
layout(location = 7) in vec4 v7_in;
layout(location = 8) in vec4 v8_in;
layout(location = 9) in vec4 v9_in;
layout(location = 10) in vec4 v10_in;
layout(location = 11) in vec4 v11_in;
layout(location = 12) in vec4 v12_in;
layout(location = 13) in vec4 v13_in;
layout(location = 14) in vec4 v14_in;
layout(location = 15) in vec4 v15_in;
void main()
{
	vec4 v0 = v0_in;
	vec4 v1 = unpack_normpacked3(v1_packed);
	vec4 v2 = unpack_normpacked3(v2_packed);
	vec4 v3 = unpack_normpacked3(v3_packed);
	vec4 v4 = v4_in;
	vec4 v5 = v5_in;
	vec4 v6 = v6_in;
	vec4 v7 = v7_in;
	vec4 v8 = v8_in;
	vec4 v9 = v9_in;
	vec4 v10 = v10_in;
	vec4 v11 = v11_in;
	vec4 v12 = v12_in;
	vec4 v13 = v13_in;
	vec4 v14 = v14_in;
	vec4 v15 = v15_in;
	vec4 r0 = vec4(0.0), r1 = vec4(0.0), r2 = vec4(0.0), r3 = vec4(0.0);
	vec4 r4 = vec4(0.0), r5 = vec4(0.0), r6 = vec4(0.0), r7 = vec4(0.0);
	vec4 r8 = vec4(0.0), r9 = vec4(0.0), r10 = vec4(0.0), r11 = vec4(0.0);
	vec4 oPos = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 oD0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), oD1 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 oB0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), oB1 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 oT0 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), oT1 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 oT2 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), oT3 = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec4 oFog = vec4(1.0), oPts = vec4(point_size), oUnused = vec4(0.0);
	int a0 = 0;
	vec4 A, B, C, mac, ilu;
	vec4 clip_position = vec4(0.0);
	bool clip_captured = false;
	/* 0 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[0].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.x = mac.x;
	/* 1 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[1].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.y = mac.y;
	/* 2 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[2].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.z = mac.z;
	/* 3 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[3].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oPos.w = mac.w;
	/* 4 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[15].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT0.x = mac.x;
	/* 5 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[16].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT0.y = mac.y;
	/* 6 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[17].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT1.x = mac.x;
	/* 7 */
	A = v4.xyzw;

	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT1.y = mac.y;

	A = v4.xyzw;

	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT2.x = mac.x;
	/* 9 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[20].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT2.y = mac.y;
	/* 10 */
	A = v4.xyzw;

	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT3.x = mac.x;
	/* 11 */
	A = v4.xyzw;
	B = c[22].xyzw;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	oT3.y = mac.y;
	/* 12 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[9].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r8.x = mac.x;
	/* 13 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[10].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r8.y = mac.y;
	/* 14 */
	A = v0.xyzw;
	B = c[8].xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz) + B.w);
	r8.z = mac.z;
	/* 15 */
	A = v4.wwww;
	B = v4.xyzw;
	C = -r8.xyzw;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.xy = mac.xy;
	/* 16 */
	A = v1.xyzw;
	B = -c[5].xyzw;
	C = v1.xyzw;
	mac = vec4(dot(A.xyz, B.xyz));
	r10.x = mac.x;
	/* 17 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = v4.zzzz;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = max(A, B);
	r8.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 18 */
	A = r8.xyzw;
	B = r8.xyzw;
	C = v0.xyzw;

	r8.xy = mac.xy;

	B = v4.wwww;
	C = v4.xyzw;
	mac = min(A, B);
	r8.xyz = mac.xyz;
	/* 20 */
	A = r8.xxxx;
	B = v0.xyzw;
	C = r8.yyyy;
	mac = A + C;
	r8.x = mac.x;
	/* 21 */
	A = r8.zzzz;
	B = c[11].xxxx;
	C = v0.xyzw;
	mac = A * B;
